name: Sentinel (Copernicus)
description: Europe's flagship Earth-observation programme — Sentinel-1 (C-band radar imaging), Sentinel-2 (multispectral optical), Sentinel-3 (ocean + land), Sentinel-5P (atmospheric chemistry), Sentinel-6 (altimetry). All sun-synchronous near 700 km. Free + open data policy.
scale_fact: Every wildfire, flood, oil spill, and forest-loss alert you've seen in the news this decade came from a Sentinel image.
